The '''Mission to Vorzyd IV''' was undertaken by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]].

==Prelude==
While [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] were at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the the people of [[Vorzyd IV]] asked for assistance in a matter concerning sabotage against their monitoring systems.

==The Mission==
When the two Jedi arrived at the planet, they met with [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Port]]. He told them that someone had been sabotaging their monitoring systems and it was causing problems for their work. After much investigation. The Jedi learned it was a group called the [[Freelies]] who were doing the sabotaging. The group was being lead by the chairman's own son, [[Grath (Vorzydiak)|Grath]]. The group wanted to change their parents "Work-only" lifestyle to a more easy one. Believing that a more perfect society could be achieved by balancing work and recreation. Many believe that their reason was because of their close connection with the "Gambler's World," [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]], which had many [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and [[amusement park]]s. Nevertheless, they would assist Obi-Wan and his master, Qui-Gon in restoring peace to the planet.<ref name="Threat" />

==Aftermath==
The two groups would live together in peace for a quite some time. Afterward, in the wake of the great [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Freelies began attacks on neighboring planet [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. They captured [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] while Luke Skywalker was present on the planet, and they began a debacle with a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], resulting in many deaths.<ref name="Gambler">"[[Gambler's World]]"</ref>
